answer: Work waits on the wharf until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the orchard of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the timber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
